# Friedrich Naumann Foundation for Freedom

> A German liberal foundation advancing freedom, democracy, and human rights through political education, international partnerships, and policy analysis across global hubs.

The Friedrich Naumann Foundation (Friedrich-Naumann-Stiftung für die Freiheit) is a Germany-based think tank and political education organization with a network of regional offices and five global hubs focused on security, innovation, development, human rights, and world order. It provides scholarships, conducts research, and engages in civic education from a liberal democratic perspective.

## Key Topics

- Liberal democracy
- Human rights
- Global security
- Digital innovation
- Development cooperation
- Political education
- European security
- World order
- International relations
- Geopolitics
- Civil society
- Women's rights
- Think tank
- Germany

## Global Research Hubs

- [Global Security Hub](https://www.freiheit.org/global-security-hub): Defense policy and European security analysis from liberal perspective
- [Global Security Hub (German)](https://www.freiheit.org/de/global-security-hub): German-language hub for defense and geopolitical security analysis
- [Global World Order and Globalization Hub](https://www.freiheit.org/global-world-order-and-globalization-hub): Washington-based analysis of global economy, trade, and international relations
- [Global World Order Hub (German)](https://www.freiheit.org/de/world-order-and-globalization-hub-0): German-language hub for globalization and world economic policy
- [Global Innovation Hub](https://www.freiheit.org/global-innovation-hub): Taipei-based hub for digital transformation, AI, and democracy innovation
- [Global Innovation Hub (German)](https://www.freiheit.org/de/global-innovation-hub): German-language hub for digital democracy and liberal innovation
- [Human Rights Hub](https://www.freiheit.org/human-rights-hub-0): Geneva-based hub advancing human rights, civil society, and UN engagement
- [Human Rights Hub (German)](https://www.freiheit.org/de/de/human-rights-hub): German-language hub for freedom, human rights, and liberal democracy
- [Global Partnership Hub](https://www.freiheit.org/global-partnership-hub): Nairobi hub for equal-footed development cooperation with Global South
- [Global Partnership Hub (German)](https://www.freiheit.org/de/global-partnership-hub): German-language hub for development cooperation and partnerships

## Foundation Overview

- [Homepage](https://www.freiheit.org): Main portal with news, events, and international affairs coverage
- [About the Foundation](https://www.freiheit.org/foundation): Foundation mission, history, and liberal political education approach
- [Scholarships Program](https://www.freiheit.org/scholarships-friedrich-naumann-foundation-freedom): Doctoral and student funding based on liberal democratic values

## Regional Offices

- [Foundation Head Office - Potsdam](https://www.freiheit.org/office/foundation-head-office-potsdam): Potsdam headquarters at Truman House and institutional base
- [Headquarters - Potsdam (German)](https://www.freiheit.org/de/buero/stiftungssitz-potsdam): German-language information on Potsdam main office
- [Capital Office Division - Berlin](https://www.freiheit.org/office/capital-office-division): Berlin office managing federal programs and regional operations
- [Berlin Office (German)](https://www.freiheit.org/de/buero/hauptstadtbuero): German-language Berlin office for political events and civic engagement
- [State Office Bavaria](https://www.freiheit.org/office/state-office-bayern): Bavaria regional office for civic education and political participation
- [State Office Bavaria (German)](https://www.freiheit.org/de/buero/landesbuero-bayern): German-language Bavaria office for liberal education and events
